description.purpose: The bookkeeper of the TTL. Every tick it reads the grants whose expires_at has passed, reads their newest event in one select, and writes an `expired` row plus an audit row for each one that was still live. Idempotent: the tick after it finds `expired` as the newest event and writes nothing.
description.use_when: Inside the access hive, driven by ./clock.
description.not_in_scope: It does NOT enforce the TTL -- ./invoke does, by comparing expires_at on every call. A colony whose timer never fires is behind on its history, not open on its door. It writes no grants and revokes nothing on its own judgement.
